_comment: SWDev: place this file at <project>/.claude/settings.json (create the .claude folder; merge if one exists). Permission stance: the PROJECT tree is fully editable without prompts (acceptEdits + allow Edit/Write ./**), the FRAMEWORK is readable without prompts (additionalDirectories + allow Read) and mechanically NON-editable (deny beats everything; //c/... = C:\...). Common build commands are pre-approved in 'allow' — extend that list for your stack rather than answering prompts one by one. Git is mechanically DENIED: version control is the human owner's job, done by hand if at all; agents never init/commit. Hooks wired: the PreToolUse guard (denies edits to locked-tier governed Contract files and hard-stop paths per .swdev/guard.json, logs contract-delta events for notify-tier edits — still blocks regardless of acceptEdits), the Bash auto-approver (silently allows safe project-local commands, incl. copies FROM the framework INTO the project, so they never prompt; anything else falls back to normal prompts), the telemetry hook (logs subagent launches / skill invocations / completions / session starts to .swdev/log/telemetry.jsonl — never blocks), and the Stop reminder (progress.md discipline). If the framework lives elsewhere than C:/GitHub/AI/SWDev, update ALL paths. Requires python on PATH.
